pr.title: Revert #133418 (Store coverage source regions as `Span`) due to regression #133606
pr.description:
This reverts commit adf9b5fcd1de43eaf0a779e10612caee8b47bede, reversing changes made to af1ca153d4aed5ffe22445273aa388a8d3f8f4ae.

Reverting #133418 due to regressions reported at #133606.

r? jieyouxu
pr.author: Zalathar

analysis.summary: This revert restores early `SourceRegion` construction and validation in `InstrumentCoverage`, instead of storing raw `Span`s and validating each mapping later during LLVM coverage map generation. The regression was serious enough that #133418 was reverted. The historical test updates show zero-width coverage spans being expanded to adjacent braces before emission (`14:10 - 14:10` became `14:9 - 14:10`; `21:2 - 21:2` became `21:1 - 21:2`; `14:39 - 14:39` became `14:38 - 14:39`). The key MCDC invariant is also restored: emit an `MCDCDecision` only when all conditions and the decision span produced valid source regions; otherwise downgrade all conditions to ordinary `Branch` mappings.
analysis.originalLogic: During `InstrumentCoverage`, `create_mappings` converts each mapping span into a concrete `SourceRegion` immediately, using the source map and the extracted HIR body span. Empty spans are first expanded to cover an adjacent `{` or `}`, and regions are retained only if all coordinates are nonzero, `end_col`'s high bit is clear, and `(start_line, start_col) <= (end_line, end_col)`. For MCDC, the decision mapping is emitted only if every condition and `decision.span` successfully convert; otherwise the conditions are emitted as ordinary `MappingKind::Branch` mappings. Codegen consumes already-validated numeric source regions.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: Store the raw `Span` in each coverage `Mapping` and defer conversion/validation to LLVM coverage map generation in `mapgen/spans.rs`, filtering each mapping independently at codegen time (the reverted code does `let Some(cov_span) = make_cov_span(span) else { continue };`). This delays empty-span expansion and source-region validation, and it decouples MCDC condition filtering from decision emission: a decision mapping can be emitted even when individual condition spans are later skipped. The revert restores the earlier `SourceRegion` representation and atomic MCDC decision/condition handling.
analysis.inputDomain: Coverage-instrumented Rust functions whose mappings contain zero-width/ambiguous spans (for example spans ending at a closing brace or after an expression) or MCDC branch/decision groups whose condition or decision spans may fail source-region conversion. The supplied tests cover ordinary conditionals, match arms, and coverage mappings observed after `CleanupPostBorrowck`.
analysis.trigger: Compile a coverage-instrumented function using the `Span`-storing/deferred-validation transformation where a mapping span is empty or otherwise invalid, or where an MCDC decision has condition spans that do not all convert. The incorrect path can emit zero-width/invalid regions or leave a decision mapping while dropping individual condition mappings.
preconditions: Coverage instrumentation is enabled for the function.
The function has coverage mappings, including at least one empty span or an MCDC decision with multiple condition mappings.
The mapping's source file must be resolved relative to the function body span; coverage mappings are currently expected to be in the same file as the body span.
Source-region validation requires nonzero 1-based coordinates, an unset high bit in `end_col`, and ordered start/end positions.
pitfalls: Do not validate/filter MCDC conditions independently after the decision has already been queued. If any condition or the decision span is invalid, emit no `MCDCDecision`; downgrade all conditions to `MappingKind::Branch` instead.

Empty mapping spans must be expanded to an adjacent `{` or `}` before coordinate conversion; otherwise zero-width regions can be emitted, as shown by the old expectations `14:10 - 14:10`, `21:2 - 21:2`, and `14:39 - 14:39`.
`llvm-cov` can reject improperly ordered or zero/misinterpreted coordinates; invalid regions should be dropped before codegen rather than relying on later filtering.
The old path's per-mapping `make_cov_span` filtering can skip one condition while the decision mapping remains, violating the MCDC decision/condition relationship.
MIR-dump expectations use numeric `SourceRegion` formatting after the revert (`line:col - line:col`) rather than path-bearing `Span` formatting (`$DIR/file:line:col: line:col (#0)`).
The same coverage metadata is visible in downstream `CleanupPostBorrowck` dumps, so changes to source-region construction affect both the instrumentation dump and later cleanup expectations.
analysis.testStrategy: Use the `tests/mir-opt/coverage` tests with coverage instrumentation and inspect both `InstrumentCoverage` and downstream `CleanupPostBorrowck` MIR dumps. Include a zero-width-span case such as a match-arm/conditional ending at a brace and verify expansion: old `14:10 - 14:10` becomes `14:9 - 14:10`, old `21:2 - 21:2` becomes `21:1 - 21:2`, and old `14:39 - 14:39` becomes `14:38 - 14:39`. Add an MCDC case where one condition/decision source region is invalid and verify that no `MCDCDecision` is emitted and all valid conditions become ordinary `Branch` mappings. Keep the source program fixed while switching between early `SourceRegion` conversion and deferred `Span` conversion so the mapping representation is the only varied transformation.
